components_and_boundaries:
The new README.md section will document the following implemented components and their boundaries:
1. Governed Event Guard & Goal Capture (packages/control-plane/src/governed-events.ts, packages/control-plane/src/founder-goal.ts, packages/control-plane/src/server.ts): POST /rooms/:roomId/events refuses T2 (task.dispatched.planner), T3 (plan.submitted), T4 (plan.revision_requested), T5 (plan.approved), and T22 (founder.cancel) with HTTP 403 governed_path_required. On T1 (scope.captured), captureFounderGoal validates payload.goal (non-empty string up to 20,000 characters), rejects credential-shaped material via containsCredentialMaterial (packages/journal/src/redact.ts), and records a server-computed sha256:<hex> digest in evidence_refs (kind founder_goal).
2. PlannerLoop Round Orchestration (packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts): PlannerLoop.runRound drives a single round for the architect seat (plannerAdapterId planner-v1, pinned on google / antigravity / gemini-4-argon-high). It derives a deterministic command ID (plannerCommandIdFor -> cmd_planner_<32-hex> from roomId, round, attempt) and caps each round at MAX_ROUND_ATTEMPTS (3: initial attempt 1 plus up to 2 automatic retries when the Gateway affirmatively proves not_sent under retryBudgetTransition). Opening attempt 1 from SCOPED commits T2 (task.dispatched.planner) and the command-journal journaled stage in a single Postgres transaction under room lock (L3) then journal lock (L4). Before any Gateway contact, authorizeRoute verifies active route-authorization coverage. The four journal stages—journaled, identity_bound (recording Gateway attestation digest and key version), dispatched (requiring non-empty initModel and providerConversationId on the antigravity/google lane under payload schema BRJ:c:2), and completed/failed—are written in lockstep with execution.
3. Gateway Planner Channel, Worker, and AgyPlannerExecutor (packages/control-plane/src/gateway/planner-channel.ts, packages/gateway-daemon/src/planner-worker.ts, packages/gateway-daemon/src/planner-executor-factory.ts, packages/gateway-daemon/src/agy-planner-executor.ts): GatewayPlannerPort posts work into an in-memory per-room mailbox (GatewayPlannerChannel) polled by the room's assigned Gateway over signed HTTP endpoints (POST /control-plane/gateways/:gatewayId/planner-poll and planner-report). GatewayPlannerWorker persists a write-ahead record per command in PlannerRecordStore (planner/<sha256>.json), writing starting before invoking the executor so an interrupted spawn never fabricates a not_sent proof. choosePlannerExecutor selects AgyPlannerExecutor on Linux for pinned Gateway 1880c12d-d98d-4a91-b25a-23320aa7f58a when BUILDROOM_PLANNER_EXECUTOR is agy. AgyPlannerExecutor verifies the root-owned agy binary copy against its pinned SHA-256 digest, prepares an anonymous read-only git checkout at baseSha owned by the unprivileged planner user, spawns agy under sudo -n -u <plannerUser> with PINNED_AGY_ARGUMENTS, gates prompt delivery on reading the init line (model gemini-4-argon-high and non-empty conversation_id) before writing work to stdin, persists durable evidence to planner-evidence/<sha256>.json, reaps residual processes via a two-rule sudo/pkill contract verified by pgrep, and writes fail-closed planner-halted.json if post-reap verification fails.
4. PlanDoc Validation & Append-Only PlanStore (packages/seat-output-schema/src/plandoc.ts, packages/control-plane/src/plan-doc.ts, packages/journal/src/plandoc.ts, packages/control-plane/src/plan-store.ts, packages/control-plane/src/migrations.ts): judgeRoundPlan validates the returned JSON against PLANDOC_SCHEMA_V1 (schema_version plandoc/1, claims.plan_approved false, claims.builder_authorized false, next_role founder_approval), validates canonical repo-relative scope_paths, verifies repository, base_sha, and scope containment against the room's captured T1 scope, requires terminal_status PLAN_READY_FOR_FOUNDER_APPROVAL, and computes the canonical BRJ:b:1 SHA-256 plan_hash. submitRoundPlan commits T3 (plan.submitted), PlanStore.recordPlan (migration 0010_plan_store, table build_room_plans, verifying the T3 lifecycle event in the same transaction via xmin = pg_current_xact_id()::xid and rejecting credential material), and the journal completed stage in one transaction.
5. Crash Recovery (packages/control-plane/src/planner-recovery.ts): PlannerRecovery.recoverRoom verifies the room's journal hash chain from genesis before inspecting open planner commands, then reconciles an open journaled/identity_bound, dispatched, or unresolved command by its deterministic command ID via PlannerPort.reconcile without re-executing the planner.
6. Plan Read, Founder Plan-Decision, and Counted-Run Surfaces (packages/control-plane/src/plan-read.ts, packages/control-plane/src/plan-decision.ts, packages/control-plane/src/counted-run.ts, packages/control-plane/src/counted-run-config.ts): GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan (guarded by CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN) reads and re-judges the latest T3 plan from build_room_plans (returning 409 plan_changed if superseded mid-read). POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision (guarded exclusively by PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN, returning 503 plan_decision_disabled when unset) executes T5 (plan.approved), T4 (plan.revision_requested with required feedback up to 20,000 characters and founder_feedback digest), or T22 (founder.cancel, allowed only once a planner command exists, deriving runningTasksCancelled or marking pending commands unresolved with unconfirmedCancelRecorded) in one transaction with a decision journal entry (founder-credential/PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN). Counted-run routes (POST/GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round and GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/journal) remain absent unless both PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN and PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN are configured.
7. Phase 4 Counted-Run Harness (packages/run-harness/src/phase4/cli.ts, runner.ts, http-driver.ts, entry.ts, run-unit.ts, run-sequence.ts, run-set.ts, attempt-store.ts, live-check.ts, export-reader.ts, model.ts): npm run phase4:counted-run executes one counted-run label per invocation (Phase4-CR1, Phase4-CR2, or Phase4-CR3) under an exclusive run.lock and durable attempts.json, enforces the Phase4-CR1 Round 1 live check on init_model and provider_conversation_id, saves plan-<planHash>.json at plan_review for Founder inspection before adjudication, and evaluates the three-run set against Phase 4 invariants.
interfaces_and_contracts:
The README.md update does not alter any code interface; it documents the following contracts accurately:
- HTTP endpoints: POST /rooms/:roomId/events (T1 scope.captured with payload.goal; 403 governed_path_required on T2, T3, T4, T5, T22), GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan, POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision, POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round, GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round, GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/journal, POST /control-plane/gateways/:gatewayId/planner-poll, and POST /control-plane/gateways/:gatewayId/planner-report.
- Schemas & encodings: PLANDOC_SCHEMA_V1 (schema_version plandoc/1), canonical plan hash encoding (BRJ:b:1), and command-journal payload encoding (BRJ:c:2 with init_model and provider_conversation_id).
- Database table: build_room_plans (migration 0010_plan_store) with append-only trigger guard and same-transaction lifecycle event verification.
- CLI surface: npm run phase4:counted-run -- --label <Phase4-CR1|Phase4-CR2|Phase4-CR3> --goal-file <path> --scope <paths> [--decision approve|revise|cancel] [--feedback-file <path>].
data_flow:
The section will trace the end-to-end data flow of a Phase 4 planner round:
1. Scope Capture (T1): Caller submits scope.captured with payload.goal and scopePaths; control plane checks credential redaction, computes sha256:<hex> (founder_goal), and transitions room to SCOPED.
2. Round Open & Attestation (T2 + journaled -> identity_bound): PlannerLoop.runRound acquires room and journal advisory locks, commits T2 (task.dispatched.planner, moving room to PLANNING) and the journaled command row in one transaction, verifies route-authorization coverage, requests Gateway attestation over the signed planner channel, and writes the identity_bound stage.
3. Dispatch & Sandboxed Execution (dispatched): GatewayPlannerWorker records starting in PlannerRecordStore and invokes AgyPlannerExecutor, which checks out base_sha in a read-only directory, launches the hash-verified agy binary as the unprivileged planner user, verifies init.model === gemini-4-argon-high and non-empty conversation_id before sending the prompt over stdin, and reports the dispatch metadata back so the control plane writes the dispatched stage.
4. Plan Submission (T3 + build_room_plans + completed): Once agy emits a single JSON object and exits cleanly (followed by two-rule pkill reap and pgrep verification), the Gateway reports the parsed document. PlannerLoop runs judgeRoundPlan (PLANDOC_SCHEMA_V1 validation, scope check, BRJ:b:1 planHash computation) and commits T3 (plan.submitted, moving room to PLAN_REVIEW), PlanStore.recordPlan into build_room_plans, and the journal completed stage in a single transaction.
5. Plan Inspection & Founder Adjudication (T4 / T5 / T22): Operator reads the stored plan via GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan (which re-judges the stored JSON and verifies plan_hash). Founder submits approve (T5 -> APPROVED), revise (T4 -> PLANNING with founder_feedback digest for Round r+1), or cancel (T22 -> CANCELLED, marking any in-flight command unresolved with unconfirmedCancelRecorded) via POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision alongside an atomic decision journal row.
trust_and_security_boundaries:
The README.md section will highlight four enforced trust boundaries:
1. Three-token separation on the control plane: General control-plane routes use CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN; POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision accepts only PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN (refusing CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN so operator read access cannot adjudicate a plan); counted-run trigger/poll/journal routes require PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN and are unmounted unless PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN is enabled.
2. Signed Gateway channel: Gateway poll and report requests on /control-plane/gateways/:gatewayId/planner-poll and planner-report are authenticated with the Gateway's Ed25519 signature and checked against the room's active occupancy assignment.
3. Host execution sandbox (AgyPlannerExecutor): The planner runs on Linux under a dedicated unprivileged OS user (buildroom-planner) with a root-owned copy of the agy binary verified by SHA-256 before spawn, an anonymous read-only git checkout at base_sha, stdin gated on init.model and conversation_id before prompt write, and a fail-closed planner-halted.json latch if post-run process reaping cannot be verified.
4. Pre-write credential guard: Founder goals, Founder revision feedback, PlanStore documents, and journal payloads are scanned with containsCredentialMaterial (packages/journal/src/redact.ts) prior to persistence, and the Phase 4 harness additionally checks outputs for secret leakage before writing disk artifacts.
migration_and_compatibility: Documentation-only change in README.md. No database migrations, wire protocols, environment variables, or package exports are changed. Existing links and section headings in README.md remain intact so external references continue to resolve.
error_and_failure_behavior:
The README.md section will summarize the fail-closed error handling built into the Phase 4 loop:
- Direct T2/T3/T4/T5/T22 posts to POST /rooms/:roomId/events fail with HTTP 403 governed_path_required.
- Missing or invalid route authorization before Gateway contact records a journal failed row (reason route_authorization_failed) and transitions the room to FAILED via system.error.
- Gateway transport or pre-send errors that affirmatively prove not_sent consume the bounded retry budget (up to 3 total attempts per round); once exhausted, or on any post-dispatch failure, invalid PlanDoc, non-ready terminal_status, or scope violation, the loop records a journal failed row and transitions the room to FAILED.
- If the Gateway cannot confirm process termination after a run, AgyPlannerExecutor writes planner-halted.json and refuses all subsequent spawns until operator intervention.
- On control-plane restart, PlannerRecovery verifies the room's full journal chain from genesis first (halting on any chain tamper) and reconciles any in-flight command by deterministic command ID without re-running the planner.
observability:
The README.md section will document the four observability and evidence surfaces produced by a planner run:
1. Hash-chained room command journal (build_room_command_journal, payload schema BRJ:c:2) recording command_id, planner round/attempt, Gateway attestation digest, init_model, provider_conversation_id, plan_hash, and Founder decision entries.
2. Append-only plan store (build_room_plans, migration 0010_plan_store) binding command_id, room_id, lifecycle_event_id, canonical plan_hash (BRJ:b:1), and raw PlanDoc JSON.
3. Gateway durable records (planner/<sha256>.json in PlannerRecordStore, planner-evidence/<sha256>.json per AgyPlannerExecutor execution, and planner-halted.json on reap failure).
4. Phase 4 counted-run artifact directory (<artifactDir>/attempts.json, run.lock, and <label>/attempt-<n>/ containing plan-<planHash>.json, journal.json, events.json, and run-result.json).
